notes.title: Mellow indie adventure One Dreamer is out now
notes.content:
One Dreamer is a point and click programming adventure game about a burned-out indie developer making games. It's officially out with Native Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/09/relaxed-adventure-one-dreamer-is-out-now

notes.title: Developer Commentary Demo Available for the Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

One Dreamer will be participating in the Steam Game Festival: February 2021 from 3rd - 9th of Feb (10am PST). This will include an updated demo featuring developer commentary, a secret area and a few other hidden goodies. 

There will be a prerecorded playthrough with the developers on the [b]3rd at 5:30pm (PST)[/b]. I’ll be in the stream chat for an hour and a half to hang out and answer questions, otherwise feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/qBmAA2Q]One Dreamer Discord server[/url].

[b]Enabling Developer Commentary[/b]
[olist]
[*] Hold Tab and open the Folders App.
[*] Open the DevCommentary script in the ‘HDD/System’ folder.
[*] Change DevCommentary.enabled = true.
[*] Interact with the yellow ducks now located around the levels.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36993037/7b6a8737ac03870996bce2797d40d52daf041a64.png[/img]

Thank you for all your support,
Gareth

[url=https://twitter.com/OneDreamerGame]@OneDreamerGame[/url]

notes.title: One Dreamer Demo will be available during the Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I’m Gareth, the developer of One Dreamer. I’ve been working on the game for close to five years now with help from my close friend Ben, who composes the music. We both grew up together in Darwin, Australia and have been designing small games since we were kids.

[previewyoutube=ciD0p3h72KM;full][/previewyoutube]

One Dreamer is a narrative-driven, fully Englished voiced adventure game about an aspiring game developer named Frank. Explore strange environments, meet lively characters and solve pseudocode puzzles based on C# as you help Frank release his debut game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36993037/8ff3139925796804709661792f9868e989537caf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36993037/4c4f0c68b85b7d60aa29574c2625251cf553bcb3.gif[/img]


The demo is the same as the recently released prologue and should take around 30 minutes to complete. If you're interested in the game be sure to try it out!

notes.title: One Dreamer: Prologue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36993037/e29a3765390f42d5d73c423c129f788b875b7298.png[/img]

Hi everyone, 

One Dreamer: Prologue will be released on the 7th of May, 2020. The game will be available on Windows and macOS at launch with planned support for Linux shortly after.

The prologue provides a backstory to several main characters while showcasing the gameplay, voice acting and coding puzzles you will experience in One Dreamer. However, it isn’t necessarily chapter one and can be played as a short, conclusive story on its own.

Thank you for all your support,
Gareth

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274140

More frequent updates are posted on twitter.
https://twitter.com/OneDreamerGame
